title-group.article-title: Single-cell RNA expression of SARS-CoV-2 entry factors

abstract.p: We analysed PBMCs from COVID-19 patients.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) spreads fast1.

sec.title: Sample processing
sec.p: PBMCs were isolated by Ficoll gradient and lysed in TRIzol.
Libraries were prepared with the Illumina TruSeq kit.

sec.title: RNA-seq data processing
sec.p: Reads were aligned to GRCh38 with STAR v2.7 and counted with featureCounts; counts were normalized with DESeq2.

sec.title: Patient classification
sec.p: Severe disease was defined as requiring ICU admission.

sec.title: Data and Code Availability
sec.p: Raw counts are available in GEO under accession GSE152418.
